tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: The datasets this server holds (AI plan limits, SaaS usage limits, voice-agent $/min, AI media credits, search and scraping APIs, LLM APIs, email platforms...), with tool counts, last update and page URL.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Vendors/products covered, with ids to pass to get_tool. Optionally filter by dataset id from list_datasets.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full verified record for a product: plans with prices, limits or rates with vendor quotes, free tier, overage policy, gotchas, source URLs and check date. Pass the tool id (e.g. "claude", "cursor", "vapi", "openai-api"); a name also works.

tools.name: search_limits
tools.description: Keyword search across every plan, limit, rate and gotcha. Returns matching rows with value, vendor quote, source URL and check date. Good first call for questions like "Cursor Pro requests per month", "Retell cost per minute", "Gemini API free tier RPM".

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compact side-by-side of 2 to 6 products: each plan with price and its headline limits or rates, free tier and overage policy, with check dates. Ids as in list_tools.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Dated change log for the AI plan limits dataset: price moves, limit changes, new or removed plans, each with the vendor source. Defaults to the last 30 days.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_datasets, get_tool, search_limits · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: list_datasets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_datasets, get_tool, search_limits · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: list_datasets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
